title: Star Routes
content: Detailed itineraries for actors such as Chris Evans, who will be staying at the Ritz-Carlton in Los Angeles from March 1-5 for a film shoot, and Scarlett Johansson, who is scheduled to attend a charity event in New York City on March 10. Fans may have opportunities to spot these celebrities at their hotels or event venues.

title: Upcoming Public Events
content: The Cannes Film Festival, running from May 17-28, with appearances by Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence; the San Diego Comic-Con, from July 21-24, where cast members from the latest Marvel movie will be signing autographs; and the Venice Film Festival, from August 31 to September 10, where Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie are expected to premiere their new films.
